name: zinput_bindmap_add_default_binding
description: zInput default-binding registration adds one localized command to the current bind group and bind-map context.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred; zinput_bindmap_context provides the current VC5 attempt for this player.cpp function.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x42a500 validates fetching the localized command label, calling BindMap_Current_SetBindingRecord, adding the returned command id to the current bind group, and writing g_zInput_CommandLocIdTable[commandId].

Native smoke zinput_bindgroup_accessors_smoke initializes a bind-map system, calls zInput::BindMap_AddDefaultBinding, and verifies command-group insertion, command localization id storage, and all four binding slots on g_zInput_BindMap_Current.
